data.body: RCA complete. Repro: ibex/goitered/wrasse each have complete ACs and all children closed, but close precheck fails before verifier with 'no commit references it (nor any of its descendants)'. Code path: close_precheck._completion_precheck -> _resolved_completion_scope -> _check_work_landed -> _referencing_commits. Prior fix ferric-jet-scorpion correctly unions the parent and transitive descendants, but these closeout epics' implementation children were administrative duplicate shells: each closed child records the work as living on a replacement ticket outside the parent subtree. The accepted-id set omitted those live replacement tickets, so referencing_commits scanned only duplicate shells and found zero, while the real landed commits reference the replacements. Verdict: genuine deterministic precheck defect, not intended policy. The gate should credit closed disposition replacements (and their subtree) as evidence while still failing when no referenced/attached commit exists anywhere in that expanded evidence set.
